newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish cosmetics firm sees IPO in Aug/Sept 1997.
newsitem.headline: Polish cosmetics firm sees IPO in Aug/Sept 1997.

text.p: The Polish cosmetics firm Pollena Ewa, which seeks listing on the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse, wants to set its public share offering at the turn of August and September, Pollena's president said on Wednesday.
Krzysztof Pawlak told a news conference Pollena, which does not seek a strategic investor, would submit its issue prospectus to the Securities Commisssion by the end of April.
"The public offering will take place at the end of the summer holidays or at the beginning of September," Pawlak said, adding the firm would seek underwriters for the issue.
He said Pollena expected to raise between 8.5 and 20 million zlotys from the new issue which it will use to develop a retail network and promote a new line of cosmetics.
Pawlak added Pollena planned to buy one or two other Polish cosmetics firms and create a holding but gave no further details.
He said that according to preliminary results Pollena had a net profit of 1.3-1.4 million zlotys in 1996 on sales of 47 million zlotys against 2.5 million net and sales of 42.2 million in 1995.
